summary: Full backend + frontend testing of 'One Card Engine' redesign (iteration 95). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed covering lazy migration of 3 legacy cards (card_design v2, legacy_template preserved, all original fields intact), draft create/update/publish flow with card_design, draft hidden from /cards/explore and /public/cards, 403 for anonymous on draft and 200 for owner, QR endpoint still works, DELETE by owner works (204). Frontend: public card pages (legacy full_banner_bubble, photo, formal) render with new engine on both desktop 1920 and mobile 390 with all required data-testids (card-container[data-preset], card-title, card-avatar, card-type-chip, card-social-block, card-brand-seal) and ZERO runtime errors. Builder flow at /cards/new: style-step + preset-picker with all 8 presets (custom/classic/minimal/modern/glass/formal/photo/animated), preset click updates the main preview (verified data-preset=formal on main container after clicking preset-formal), use-style-btn transitions to editor with all 7 tabs (content/media/social/design/components/effects/type) and live-preview, title autosaves (~2.5s) and status becomes 'saved', draft auto-created with URL change to /cards/{id}/edit, contact fields (whatsapp/phone/email/website/company) generate card-action-* buttons live, publish-btn navigates to /c/{id} with same preset+title (WYSIWYG). Design tab controls present (brand-ff6a00, bg-type-gradient/animated, avatar-position/shape, font-elegant, button-style-outline, social-style-buttons, reset-design-btn). Components tab (toggle-bio, up/down-contact, toggle-qr -> card-qr-block appears). Effects tab (toggle-glass, glass-opacity slider, depth-floating, toggle-animation). Undo/redo buttons present. Mobile 390: mobile-preview-btn opens mobile-preview-sheet with QR card, undo/redo-btn-mobile present, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390). Zero pageerrors across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Public /c/{id} card for photo preset correctly disables banner (expected - photo preset uses fullimage background with banner.enabled=false).
Formal preset legacy card had no location data, so card-location-block absent is expected (data-driven, not a bug).

Preset thumbnails inside preset-picker all expose data-testid='card-container' which produces 9 elements on /cards/new (8 thumbs + 1 main preview). This is fine for visual purpose but testing selectors need .last() or specific scoping; main preview is correctly reactive to preset clicks.
